questions.question: The prophet Habakkuk wrote that the earth will be filled with what, as the waters cover the sea?

answers.text: The knowledge of the LORD's glory
The songs of the freed nations
The gold of the fallen cities

questions.question: God warned a proud man who took what was not his that survivors would plunder him. Why?

answers.text: Because he refused to pay tribute

questions.question: God warned a man who got his neighbors drunk that he would be filled with what instead of glory?
The prophet Habakkuk said idols have no breath and cannot give guidance. Where did he say the LORD is?
